content:
Hi, I have been working on two projects, Huffman Coding and Bzip2 using Burrows Wheeler Transformation in Lean, and thought I would share it today since some good progress is made.

  • LeanHuffmanCoding
  • LeanBWT-Bzip2

I am happy to share I have proved correctness theorems for both. I have also mapped the linux Bzip2 command purely in Lean from BWT, no FFI. Since Bzip2 linux needs usage huffman coding, I am using my own Huffman coding implementation for even more correctness from the other repo I mentioned.

Both are quite done but still in progress, Bzip2 linux command and my library are compatible for compression and decompression for smaller files, not too large. I have yet to prove things beyond correctness of BWT algorithm, since linux's Bzip2 uses more than just BWT, but they are part of the plan! A lot more testing will be done in coming weeks for better handling.

Thanks to Professor @Siddhartha Gadgil since the project started last year as a course project in his course Proof and Programs, at IISc Bengaluru. Also thanks to Codex for helping me out in places and especially proofs.

Any thoughts and comments are appreciated to make them better since these started out as course projects with motivation to make them a usable Library. Thanks!
